create_gemma3_image_processor: create a Gemma3ImageProcessorPil instance with custom pan_and_scan and normalization settings
run_pan_and_scan: run pan_and_scan on a numpy image array to crop it into multiple tiles based on aspect ratio
process_images_with_pan_and_scan: process a batch of images through resize, rescale, normalize with optional pan_and_scan cropping
build_preprocessed_batch: build a BatchFeature with pixel_values and num_crops from preprocessed images for model input
review_gemma3_image_processor_kwargs: review the Gemma3ImageProcessorKwargs typed dict defining optional pan_and_scan configuration parameters
